criterion: If the full resource/inventory MIP still reports the prior-floor plateau without a new qualified global bound, preserve the unfinished diagnostic and reallocate to the preselected second family as a source of a valid stronger-domain upper, followed by at most one finite family-exclusion repricing batch.
basis: The full-domain primal search remains far above the preselected second inventory price, while its reported global bound remains at the already qualified floor. A targeted same-domain feasible point can bound the enhancement's opportunity or make a subsequent proof much easier.
global_proof_method: one finite exact-member no-good batch and one original-objective price; no long no-good loop
